messages:
mia (Docs): Quick review please — updating the SOC 2 / audit-log section. Draft wording + examples below. Need legal + security sign-off before I land the PR :wave:

sam (Security): thanks. high level: avoid saying we "delete" on a hard schedule — say "retained for up to X" and call out customer-controlled retention for private deployments. also add a short note about redaction for PII in logs. :thumbsup:

eli (Legal): +1 on the phrasing. Please include a sentence that logs may be retained to satisfy legal or regulatory obligations and that retention periods can be subject to customer contracts. Also add an example retention matrix (prod vs. dev).

mia (Docs): Proposed doc paragraph (draft):
```
Audit logs: We retain audit logs to support security investigations, compliance, and contractual obligations. Typical retention windows are 90 days for development environments and 24 months for production audit records, unless otherwise required by law or by customer agreement. For private deployments, customers can configure retention settings in their console or via the retention API. Sensitive fields may be redacted before long-term storage; see the redaction guide.
```

jonah (DevEx): small nit: change "we retain" -> "Redwood retains" for consistency with other pages. Also will need an SDK snippet showing how to attach an audit-id header for traceability. I can paste one.

mia (Docs): Good call. Here's the SDK snippet for node to show adding audit metadata (will go in a code block):
```js
// attach audit metadata to requests
const response = await client.generate({
  model: 'rw-instruct-1',
  input: 'summarize this',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-audit-id': 'cust-1234-evt-5678' }
});
```

alex (Infra): Also include an example retention API payload for Dedicated/Private customers so infra teams know what to expect:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "prod-default",
  "retention_days": 730,
  "redaction": {
    "pii_fields": ["email", "ssn"],
    "method": "mask"
  }
}
```

sam (Security): Add a short sentence on immutable audit trails for SOC 2: "Audit logs are stored in append-only storage with integrity monitoring; deletions are logged and require approval." That helps auditors.

eli (Legal): Also we should not publish a specific minimum (like 24 months) as a guarantee in the public docs unless it matches product guarantees. If 24 months is only a recommended default, prefix with "recommended". If it's contractual, coordinate with sales to ensure the SLA section matches.

mia (Docs): OK — I'll change to: "Recommended retention: 90 days (dev), 24 months (prod). Actual retention is configurable and subject to contract." I'll reword the SDK snippet header comment to reference "for traceability and audit correlation".

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch docs/audit-retention-update — CI: ✅ , staging build: ✅

jonah (DevEx): One more: the link to the redaction guide currently targets /docs/redaction#audit-logs — can someone confirm that anchor exists? I can update link if it moved. :eyes:

mia (Docs): @alex can you confirm the redaction anchor? If it's different I'll update links in the PR. Planning to merge after legal ok and security quick pass. Thanks all! :pray:
